title: The Anti-Boring Meal Prep System | High -Protein Bolognese
description:
High-protein bolognese freezer prep made with extra lean ground beef and portioned into freezer cubes for easy weeknight dinners.

🍝 317 cal | 38P | 13F | 13C

Ingredients (12 servings):
• 1800g extra lean ground beef
• 2 × 900ml cans whole tomatoes
• 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
• 2 medium onions (~490g), diced
• 10 cloves garlic, minced
• 1/2 cup tomato paste
• 2.5 cups beef broth
• 2 cups Fairlife milk
• 2 tsp Italian seasoning
• 2 bay leaves
• salt & pepper, to taste

Instructions:

1. sauté the onions in olive oil until softened and lightly translucent
2. add the garlic and cook for 1–2 minutes until fragrant
3. add the beef and cook until browned with no pink remaining
4. pour in the beef broth and simmer uncovered until reduced, about 8–10 minutes
5. add the milk and continue simmering uncovered until reduced, about 8–10 minutes
6. stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, Italian seasoning, and bay leaves
7. crush the tomatoes with a spoon
8. cover and simmer for about 30 minutes
9. season with salt and pepper to taste
10. portion into cubes and freeze for up to 3–4 months

Part of my Anti-Boring Meal Prep System — keeping homemade meal components on hand for fast, high-protein dinners.
